title: Capsule Renderer Notes
description: A release-note fixture for testing grouped changes across mobile snap, mobile feed, desktop slides, and mobile story views.

sections.title: Added
sections.body: The compiler now emits a mobile feed surface alongside the scroll-snap reader, desktop slides, and mobile story sequence.

sections.title: Changed
sections.body: Mobile snap sections now occupy the full viewport and keep their fragment ids without adding visible section-jump controls.

sections.title: Fixed
sections.body: The story view now uses the native-feeling renderer pattern with progress bars, timing, pause, replay, and full-height mobile layout.

sections.title: Next
sections.body: The remaining question is which content shapes should default to reader, snap, feed, story, slides, or no alternate presentation at all.

assets.alt: Four presentation surfaces derived from one Capsule data model.

cards.title: Renderer Notes
cards.body: A changelog wants grouped scanning and quick review.

cards.title: Added
cards.body: A feed surface joined snap, slides, and story.

cards.title: Changed
cards.body: Snap sections now fill the viewport without extra jump buttons.

cards.title: Fixed
cards.body: The story renderer now behaves like a native mobile sequence.

cards.title: Next
cards.body: Use fixtures to choose defaults by content shape.
